# Clidex

> CLI tool discovery for AI agents. Search, compare, and install thousands of command-line tools with structured YAML/JSON output, from the shell or over MCP.

Clidex is a local, offline index of command-line tools with install commands for several package managers, tldr usage examples, GitHub stars, and documentation links. It is rebuilt daily and downloaded with `clidex update`.

## Installation

```bash
cargo install clidex
# or
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/syshin0116/clidex/main/install.sh | sh

clidex update    # Download the tool index
```

## MCP server

```bash
clidex mcp       # stdio; e.g. `claude mcp add clidex -- clidex mcp`
```

Tools: `search_tools(query, max_results?, category?)`, `tool_info(name)`, `compare_tools(names)`, `trending_tools(category?, updated_since?, max_results?)`, `list_categories(filter?)`. Results are `structuredContent` with an output schema. Lists default to 5 results, at most 50.

## Commands

```bash
clidex "json processor" --json               # Search
clidex "json processor" --json --fields name,install,examples -n 3
clidex batch "json processor" "git diff" --json   # One index load for many queries
clidex info jq --json                        # One tool
clidex compare jq dasel yq --json            # Side by side
clidex trending --category git --updated-since 2026-01-01
clidex categories git
clidex --category docker -n 5
clidex stats --json                          # Includes schema_version
clidex update                                # Conditional, checksum-verified download
```

Output is YAML in a pipe and pretty on a terminal unless `--json`, `--yaml`, or `--pretty` is given. `--fields` keeps only the listed tool fields, in order. `--score` adds a relevance score.

## Exit codes

- 0: success, including an empty result `[]`
- 2: invalid arguments
- 3: index missing or unreadable (run `clidex update`)
- 4: `info` or `compare` found no such tool
- 5: `clidex update` failed

With `--json`/`--yaml`, the last stderr line(s) are `{"error": {"code", "message", "exit_code"}}`.

## Output schema

```yaml
name: string
binary: string?              # Binary name, if different
desc: string
category: string             # e.g. "Files and Directories > Search"
tags: [string]
install:                     # Any of: brew, cargo, npm, pipx, pacman, apk, scoop
  brew: "brew install jq"
examples:                    # Up to 3, from tldr-pages; {{...}} is a placeholder
  - description: string
    command: string
stars: number?
brew_installs_365d: number?
last_updated: string?        # Last GitHub push
links:
  repo: string?
  homepage: string?
  docs: string?
  llms_txt: string?          # llms.txt URL for LLM-readable docs
```

Within a `schema_version`, fields are only added. Ignore unknown keys.

## Data sources

awesome-cli-apps, toolleeo/cli-apps, modern-unix, awesome-tuis, Homebrew (formulae, casks, analytics), crates.io, npm, PyPI, Repology (pacman, apk, scoop), tldr-pages (examples, CC BY 4.0), GitHub API, and llms.txt probing. Install commands and examples are only attached when the source can be tied to the same project.
